name: HealthBench Professional
intro: HealthBench Professional 是 OpenAI 面向真实临床医生聊天任务发布的开放基准，包含从 15,079 个候选中分层筛选的 525 个任务，覆盖会诊、写作与文档、医学研究三类常见工作。190 名医生参与创作与三阶段复核，困难样本相对候选池富集约 3.5 倍，约三分之一来自医生红队测试。
build_method: 真实医生聊天采集, 三阶段医生复核, 难度分层抽样, 医生Rubric标注
metric: 长度校正的医生Rubric分数, 场景与专科切片
task_type: 开放式临床对话, 医疗专业任务
eval_feature: 真实临床工作流, 医生红队, 专科匹配人类基线, 模型Rubric裁判, 长度校正
scale: 525个任务（从15,079个候选筛选）；190名医生
task_type_en: Open-ended clinician chat, professional medical tasks
build_method_en: Real clinician chats, three-stage physician review, difficulty-stratified sampling, physician-authored rubrics
eval_feature_en: Real clinical workflows, physician red teaming, specialist-matched human baseline, model rubric grader, length adjustment
intro_en: HealthBench Professional is OpenAI's open benchmark of real clinician-chat tasks. Its 525 tasks were stratified from 15,079 candidates across care consult, writing and documentation, and medical research. A cohort of 190 physicians contributed authorship and three-stage review; difficult examples are enriched by about 3.5 times and roughly one-third are physician red-teaming cases.
scale_en: 525 tasks selected from 15,079 candidates; 190 physician contributors
metric_en: Length-adjusted physician-rubric score, use-case and specialty slices
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2604.27470, especially Sections 2-4 and 8, plus the official OpenAI release page and dataset schema. HealthBench Professional is a separate 2026 open benchmark that complements HealthBench; it is not a Claude system-card split. 190 physicians with experience across 50 countries and 26 specialties authored or reviewed real ChatGPT for Clinicians conversations from good-faith use and deliberate red teaming. Stage 1 creates the conversation, example-specific signed rubric, and Likert 1-7 difficulty rating; Stage 2 checks realism, difficulty, and rubric quality, with two independent physicians verifying difficult cases; Stage 3 adjudicates ambiguity and removes subjective criteria. Metadata tags drive stratified selection of 525 tasks from 15,079 candidates, enriching difficult examples about 3.5 times, with roughly one-third red teaming. Specialist-matched physicians provide unbounded-time, web-enabled responses for all tasks. GPT-5.4 at low reasoning grades each criterion independently; met signed points are normalized by maximum positive points, then an empirically estimated response-length adjustment is applied before clipped mean and slice reporting.
